defects: The 10px vertical padding is dropped rather than kept; the 44px height is set and text is centred instead.
Focus and error rings use raw rgba values (rgba(11,92,173,0.25) and rgba(180,35,24,0.25)) instead of tokens.
Focus border stays 1px and the 2px look is simulated with an inset box-shadow, so the design's 2px border is not literally reproduced.
Error ring is an invented state not in the design (disclosed in notes).
A.notes: The error state is driven by '.text-field__input[aria-invalid="true"]' and the disabled state by ':disabled', with '.text-field:has(> .text-field__input:disabled) .text-field__label' for the label, so no hand-toggled class is needed. Notes disclose the 6px gaps, the dropped 10px padding, the undrawn hover and read-only states, and the alert icon asset, but the 10px drop is the one value that misses the key.

defects: Component width is a fixed 'width: 320px' on '.text-field' (max-width: 100% only shrinks it), not the fluid width the key requires.
Focus sets 'border-width: 2px' on '.text-field__control' with no padding compensation, so the field's content box shifts by 1px on focus.
Error styling is keyed to a '.text-field--error' modifier class rather than [aria-invalid="true"], so the error state is hand-toggled.
Disabled colours are keyed to '.text-field--disabled' classes; only the cursor uses :disabled.
The 10px vertical padding is not kept or mentioned in notes.md.
notes.md does not mention hover, read-only, or the focus-plus-error combination as undrawn states.
B.notes: The 6px gaps, 44px control, 12px horizontal padding, token colours and the 3px focus ring with 25% accent are correctly built using 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 25%, transparent)'. The misses are the fixed 'width: 320px', the focus 'border-width: 2px' that shifts layout, and error/disabled states driven by '.text-field--error' and '.text-field--disabled' classes rather than '[aria-invalid="true"]' and ':disabled'.

h3-text-field.reason: A meets 34 of 35 checks, with state styling on aria-invalid and :disabled and no layout shift on focus, while B meets 28 and keys error and disabled styling on hand-toggled classes, uses a fixed 320px width and shifts the layout on focus.
